description: This file contains helper functions for testing the behavior of the 'git read-tree' command under various conditions, including success and failure scenarios, with and without dry-run options. The functions are used to verify that the command behaves correctly and does not alter the index or work tree unexpectedly during dry-runs.

methods.name: read_tree_must_succeed
methods.description: Ensures 'git read-tree' succeeds with given arguments, verifying that the index remains unchanged.

methods.name: read_tree_must_fail
methods.description: Ensures 'git read-tree' fails with given arguments, verifying that the index remains unchanged.

methods.name: read_tree_u_must_succeed
methods.description: Ensures 'git read-tree' with the -u option succeeds and does not alter the working directory files.

methods.name: read_tree_u_must_fail
methods.description: Ensures 'git read-tree' with the -u option fails and does not alter the working directory files.
